reflectionRules.templateCopy: Your responses describe experiences that may be worth continuing to observe over time.
Your responses suggest bleeding is an important part of this observation, especially how it affects planning, movement, rest, or daily routines.
Your responses describe bleeding together with weakness, dizziness, or faintness. This may be important to discuss with a healthcare provider, especially if it continues or worsens.
Your responses suggest pain or pressure has become a meaningful pattern in your experience.
Your responses show symptoms that may be connected to cycle timing, ovulation, or changes in rhythm.
Your responses describe changes in body rhythm and hormonal signs that may be useful to track together.
Some of what you described may be affecting your daily life more than expected.
Your responses suggest that getting answers or feeling heard has been part of the experience.
Some experiences are more personal to describe. Your responses still help preserve patterns that may matter over time.
Some responses were marked as potentially urgent. Womb Atlas is not an emergency service; please seek local urgent or emergency care if symptoms feel severe or unsafe.
Your Atlas Record shows patterns across more than one domain, which may be useful to review over time or share with a provider if you choose.
